The barrier is then measured on the straight line, a trained Bezier curve and a trained one-bend polychain. The aligned linear barrier falls with width for every kind of pair. At width 5, three of four pairs that both rely on cue A keep a loss barrier of 0.09 to 0.25 after the exhaustive search, about as much as pairs relying on different cues (0.15 to 0.54). At widths 64 and 256 an A-net and a B-net are connected after activation matching (0.000). A copy of a net, permuted and rescaled per unit, computes exactly the same function, yet permutation alignment alone leaves it a barrier of 0.19 to 0.59. In a load-by-temperature grid, one cell is flat and poorly connected without alignment. There, alignment plus a trained curve removes the barrier, while the aligned straight line keeps 0.07 error, and the cell's accuracy deficit stays. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |

Forward passes of GPT-2 small and Pythia-70m, in numpy on CPU, gave the final-layer-norm output f(x) over about 3,200 contexts, and the unembeddings gave G. Exactly, both models meet the diversity condition: the unembeddings span the whole space, and the final layer norm's bias leaves every f(x) with a fixed nonzero component off the hyperplane its normalisation confines it to, so F is the whole space too. Then M = N = ℝᵈ and the containments Γ ⊆ N and Γ_q ⊆ M hold for any relation. At the tolerance stated before the run (singular values above 1e-3 of the largest; at most 1% of any direction outside), they fail for all three relations tested (city in country, country language, country capital) in GPT-2 small, whose context spectrum is dominated by one direction, and fail narrowly for Γ ⊆ N in Pythia-70m, where f is constant, to within 2.4e-4, along one direction. A post-hoc sweep shows the verdict turning on the tolerance. City in country is fairly linear in GPT-2 small (held-out R² 0.82); the other relations less so. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
